business_summary: Excite Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the platform, medical, broadband, and SaaS/DX businesses in Japan. It provides various services comprising woman excite, a media platform for working mothers; excite news, a news media platform that provides information, such as news, entertainment, trends, interesting stories, drama and movie reviews, columns, and interviews; Excite phone fortune telling, a platform service that sends fortunes through the phone or by email; Excite Advice Room, an online counseling service; EMININAL, an orthopedic treatment system; M&A BASE, a platform that provides mergers and acquisitions advisory, intermediation, due diligence and PMI support, and M and A strategy planning; and ONE MEDICAL, an online support system for medical appointments, medical interviews, consultations with doctors, and follow-ups. The company also offers BB Excite, an internet service provider that provides fiber optic lines, internet connection services, SIM cards, smartphones, and others; Job training, a job-seeker support training school; and operates NAPBIZ blog that focuses on managing influencers, as well as undertakes influencer marketing business. In addition, it provides KUROTEN, a business management cloud solution that manages forecasts, management accounting sales results, ledgers, KPIs, and personal data; FanGrowth, a webinar PDCA cloud platform; Sharely, a service that offers support for hosting and running virtual general shareholders' meetings; and Subscribe, a subscription service introduction support tool. Excite Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
